A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-L-atpeace-PC-Errata-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[At Peace]]: The game text changes: “'rests' (may” becomes “may”; “Tests)” becomes “Tests”; “turn; then” becomes “turn. At any time, may”; “from apprentice” is added after “relocate Immediate Effect”; “a” is added after “Immediate Effect to”; “When attempting this test, that apprentice” becomes “Apprentice”; “destiny.” becomes “destiny of this test.”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole 2022 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
